entry.title: Single-Slot Finality under Sub-Sampling DAS via Threshold BLS Aggregation Trees
entry.summary:
Scaling BFT consensus to over $10^6$ validators in a single $12$-second slot is bottlenecked by signature aggregation ingress and peer-to-peer gossip fanout. Combining erasure-coded data availability sampling (PeerDAS) with rateless algebraic signature aggregation bounds per-node bandwidth below $4.5\text{ MB/s}$ while guaranteeing two-round finality.

Source: Ethereum Research (ethresear.ch) · Tags: #consensus #zkp #distributed-systems
